name: pread
synopsis: ssize_t pread(int fd, void *buf, size_t count, off_t offset);
ssize_t pwrite(int fd, const void *buf, size_t count, off_t offset);
description: pread() reads up to count bytes from file descriptor fd at a specified offset without changing the file offset.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Buffer to store the data read

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset from the beginning of the file

return_value.success: Returns the number of bytes read (a return of zero indicates end of file)
return_value.failure: Returns -1 and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: See read(2) and lseek(2) for possible errors

bugs: On Linux, if a file is opened with O_APPEND, pwrite() appends data regardless of offset, contrary to POSIX requirements.
